title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Davidson College
description: Explore the essential late-night dining spots and rituals that fuel Davidson College students, from on-campus cafes to nearby 24-hour classics.

cards.title: Late-Night Fuel at the Union
cards.subtitle: Located in the Alvarez College Union
cards.notes: Visit the third floor for smash burgers and flatbreads. It serves as a primary social hub for students seeking a hot meal during late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A central campus bistro offering hot meals and grab-and-go snacks until midnight during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Café is located on the third floor of the Alvarez College Union and offers late-night dining options until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM during the academic semester.

cards.title: The Campus Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: Upper level of Vail Commons
cards.notes: Stop by for pizza starting at 8 p.m. or grab fresh-baked cookies. It is the go-to spot for dorm essentials and midnight snacks.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store known for late-night pizza and a wide variety of snacks and household items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons Market is open late most nights and serves pizza starting at 8 p.m. every night.
cards.source_title: Battle of the On-Campus Dining Locations at Davidson College
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic year; check current seasonal hours for exact closing.

cards.title: The 'Nummit' Study Session
cards.subtitle: Patterson Court Circle
cards.notes: Head to 'Nummit' for a student-run coffeehouse experience. It hosts trivia and live music, making it a favorite for evening social study groups.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed on-campus coffee shop and social hub located in the heart of Patterson Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Summit Coffee Outpost, often called 'Nummit', is a student-run cafe on campus that hosts events like trivia and live music.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open for evening study and events.

cards.title: Main Street Scoop Run
cards.subtitle: 202 South Main Street
cards.notes: Walk across the street for a late-night waffle cone. It stays open until 10 p.m. on weekends, providing a classic dessert destination for students.
cards.short_summary: A popular ice cream shop located directly across from campus on Main Street, offering late-night treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Ben & Jerry's in Davidson is open until 10:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Davidson, NC Ice Cream Shop - Ben & Jerry's
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Tradition
cards.subtitle: Huntersville Gateway Blvd
cards.notes: Drive south to Huntersville for the quintessential 24-hour diner experience. It is a reliable destination for breakfast food at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner located a short drive from campus, serving as a staple for late-night student excursions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle House location in Huntersville is open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: The Late-Night Tray Run
cards.subtitle: Huntersville Gateway Blvd
cards.notes: Order a 'Cook Out Tray' with a milkshake from over 40 flavors. The drive-thru stays open until 3:30 a.m. or later, making it a student favorite.
cards.short_summary: A regional fast-food chain famous for its late-night drive-thru and extensive milkshake menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Out locations typically operate until 3:30 AM or 4:30 AM, serving their full menu late into the night.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 3:30 AM (Sun-Thu) and 4:30 AM (Fri-Sat).

cards.title: Finals Week Tradition
cards.subtitle: Vail Commons
cards.notes: Join fellow students for a late-night breakfast served by faculty and staff during finals. It provides a much-needed break from exam preparation.
cards.short_summary: A beloved Davidson tradition where students gather for a late-night meal during the final exam period.
cards.evidence_claim: The Night Owl Breakfast is an annual tradition at Davidson College held during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Occurs late at night during final exam periods; check campus calendar for dates.

cards.title: Late-Night Burrito Pickup
cards.subtitle: 204 Baker Drive
cards.notes: Use the Grubhub app to order burritos or nachos for pickup. It is a convenient option for students near the Baker Sports Complex.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus Mexican grill offering customizable entrees with late-night pickup options via mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Qdoba at Davidson College offers on-campus pickup for late-night cravings through the Grubhub app.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; check the Grubhub app for current late-night availability.

cards.title: Evening Pizza at the Brickhouse
cards.subtitle: 209 Delburg Street
cards.notes: Gather for brick-oven pizza in a relaxed atmosphere. While it has a bar, the dining side is a popular evening spot for student groups and families.
cards.short_summary: A local restaurant known for its brick-oven pizza and casual dining, located just a short walk from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Brickhouse Tavern in Davidson is open until 10:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Latin Street Food Run
cards.subtitle: 624 Jetton Street
cards.notes: Order authentic tacos or arepas for a late dinner. It provides a fresh, flavorful alternative to standard fast food within walking distance of campus.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery specializing in Latin American street food, popular for evening meals near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Sabor Latin Street Grill in Davidson is open until 9:00 PM daily.
